decisions.hidden_reasoning:
Garchomp outspeeds both? Gholdengo 104 Spe vs Garchomp 109-169 — likely faster. Dragonite 102, slower. Gholdengo resists nothing... Garchomp EQ vs Gholdengo neutral (Ground vs Steel/Ghost = 2x? Steel weak to Ground, Ghost neutral → 2x). Dragonite: EQ 2x vs Dragonite. Both weak. But Garchomp only has EQ revealed; likely also outrage etc. Send Gholdengo? Garchomp EQ hits both hard. Dragonite has Multiscale, EQ does ~half. Then Dragonite can DD or outrage. Actually send Dragonite: EQ ~50% after Multiscale, then Dragonite outrages/eq back. Garchomp likely faster though. Gholdengo can Make It Rain? Not vs Garchomp well (neutral, SpA 203 vs Def). Hmm, Garchomp HP ~200, Make It Rain 120BP neutral ~ 60%? Roughly. But Garchomp EQ 2x on Gholdengo likely OHKO or near.

Dragonite: take EQ with Multiscale (~45-50%), then Outrage KO Garchomp? Garchomp faster, EQ again → Dragonite dead unless Multiscale... second EQ full power kills. Better: Dragonite DD? No, dies.

Gholdengo: EQ 2x, ~ OHKO likely (Garchomp Atk 135-200, EQ 100BP 2x vs Def 115 → likely OHKO). So both die to EQ. But Garchomp may not spam EQ if I send Gholdengo... it's a bot.

Alternative: send Dragonite, tank EQ (Multiscale), then Extreme Speed? No, priority but weak. Outrage KO Garchomp (Dragon weak to Dragon, 120BP from 204 Atk → OHKO). So Dragonite tanks one EQ at ~50%, then Outrage KOs. If Garchomp uses Outrage on Dragonite instead, 2x, but Multiscale halves → ~50-60%, then I Outrage back KO. Either way Dragonite wins 1v1 with Multiscale. Send Dragonite.

decisions.thought: Endgame 1v1: my full Dragonite vs their full Garchomp. Garchomp outspeeds and EQs first, but Multiscale halves it (~50% damage). My Outrage (STAB, super effective on Dragon) should KO Garchomp from full even unboosted. Mega Evolving also keeps Multiscale, so Mega + Outrage is safe and stronger. If it survives, finish with Extreme Speed.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Garchomp outspeeds and EQ hits hard. Mega Dragonite: Multiscale halves first hit. Mega evolving keeps Multiscale? Mega Dragonite ability unknown—opponent's Mega Dragonite had multiscale. Mega first turn, tank EQ at half, then Outrage. But Garchomp could use Dragon moves? Unknown. Safer: Mega + Outrage now—Outrage 120 super effective, Garchomp ~200 HP, Mega Atk ~193... Outrage at 120 SE vs Garchomp (Dragon weak) likely KO? Garchomp Def ~103-161, HP ~200. Mega Dragonite Atk 193, 120 BP SE: roughly 2*(193*... rough calc: damage ≈ (((2*50/5+2)*120*193/130)/2+2)*2 ≈ (22*120*193/130)/2+2 ≈ (22*178)/... let's estimate: 42*120*193/130/50+2... standard: dmg = (22*120*193/Def)/50+2. With Def 130: 22*120*193=509,520; /130=3919; /50=78; +2=80; *1.5 SE=120; *1.5 STAB=180. KO. Even without Mega, Atk 204: 22*120*204/130/50+2≈85*2.25≈190. Also KO. So just Outrage now; Garchomp EQ first does ~half through Multiscale. Fine.
